category: document parsing API, one-time free pages

free_tier.stated: 10,000 free pages once per account, no card required, all features included; after the first 10,000 pages the API refuses further page processing unless the account is upgraded to Pay-As-You-Go at USD 0.015 a page
free_tier.notes: the unit is pages (a page, slide or image for .pdf, .pptx and .tiff; the file size divided by 100 KB for other types; the vocabulary has no page term). The 10,000-page credit is applied once per account and does not renew

per_object_cap.stated: 100 MB (104,857,600 bytes) per document on upload, parse or direct extract; one document per request; 50 MB per file through the MCP server

retention.stated: unverified: no retention period for uploaded documents or results read on the Transform pages captured

interface_detail: REST (POST https://transform.unstructured.io/api/v2/parse with an unstructured-api-key header), a Python SDK, and an MCP server
tooling: plain REST with an API key from the Transform console, the Python SDK, or the Transform MCP server in an MCP client; the endpoint takes one local file per request, with no URL ingestion
chaining: 10,000 pages with no card, once, for the file types .bmp, .docx, .heic, .jpeg, .jpg, .pdf, .png, .pptx and .tiff; the next page costs USD 0.015, so it is a one-time trial lane rather than a monthly one

limits.value: 10,000 pages once per account; further page requests fail until the account is upgraded to Pay-As-You-Go at USD 0.015 a page
100 MB (104,857,600 bytes) per document; extensions .bmp, .docx, .heic, .jpeg, .jpg, .pdf, .png, .pptx, .tiff; one document per request
unverified: the limits page states 'No public values are specified for result size, request rate, or concurrent jobs'

identity_cost.detail: a Transform account: the login page at transform.unstructured.io offers registration with an email address or Continue with Google; the pricing page states no card is required for the 10,000 free pages and a card is entered only to upgrade to Pay-As-You-Go; unverified: whether registration is open or approval-gated, since the quickstart says 'If you do not have access, contact your account team'

reliability_note: no reliability event recorded; no request was made because an API key needs a signed-in account
confidence_note: the 10,000 free pages, their one-time application, the missing card requirement, the per-page price, the 100 MB cap and the nine accepted extensions are quoted from vendor pages read on 2026-11-03; whether registration is open to anyone is unverified, and no request was made.
